spanish: Y su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is a common noun (fine flour); sólet leaves the lemma untranslated.
Qal passive participle of בלל licenses mixed or mingled, not kneaded.
מִנְחָה is a common noun (offering or gift); minjá leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: Counts, weights, singular siclo, and both vessels full stay inside the tokens.
